references.text: Samson's wife succeeds in coaxing the answer to the riddle from him, and the men give the answer on the seventh day, showing the result of the threats in verse 15.
The threat to burn her and her father's house with fire is later fulfilled when the Philistines actually burn her and her father.
A similar pattern where Samson's wife is pressured to coax secrets from him, as Delilah later does on behalf of the Philistine mission.
The proverb describes how flattering words can be used to trap someone, just as Samson's wife was asked to coax her husband.
Describes how Samson's wife wept and pressed him for seven days as a result of the threats she received.
